name: Cart Abandonment
description: Remind shoppers to complete a purchase they left behind.
html_content:
You left something behind

Hi {first_name},

You added a few items to your cart but didn't finish checking out. We saved them for you in case you want to come back.

Return to your cart

If you ran into any trouble during checkout, reply to this email and we'll help right away.

— The {company_name} Team
